description: This file contains implementation of CUDA interprocess communication (IPC) types and management functions for PyTorch, including classes and functions for handling shared CUDA tensors, reference counting, and memory cleanup.

classes.name: CudaIPCGlobalEntities
classes.description: Singleton class managing global CUDA IPC reference counters, shared files, and synchronization state.

classes.name: CudaIPCSentDataLimbo
classes.description: Class managing a limbo of sent CUDA IPC data waiting for reference count to drop to zero.

classes.name: CudaIPCSentData
classes.description: Class representing a CUDA IPC shared data block, including reference counting and event handling.

methods.name: warnProducerTerminatedBeforeSharedTensorsReleased
methods.description: Logs a warning if the producer process terminates before shared CUDA tensors are released.

methods.name: CudaIPCGlobalEntities::safe_clean_current_file
methods.description: Cleans up the current reference counter file if no offsets are in use.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentDataLimbo::~CudaIPCSentDataLimbo
methods.description: Destructor that collects remaining data and warns if data still exists.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentDataLimbo::collect
methods.description: Collects and frees shared blocks with zero reference count.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentDataLimbo::add
methods.description: Adds a shared block to the limbo, with warning if too many blocks are in limbo.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentDataLimbo::size
methods.description: Returns the number of shared blocks in limbo.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentDataDelete
methods.description: Deletes a shared data block, returning reference count and adding to limbo if needed.

methods.name: ReturnRefCounter
methods.description: Returns a reference counter for a shared CUDA handle, erasing the file if no offsets are in use.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentData::CudaIPCSentData
methods.description: Constructor initializing shared data with CUDA event handling based on device and environment.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentData::~CudaIPCSentData
methods.description: Destructor that returns reference counter and destroys CUDA event if used.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentData::counter_value
methods.description: Returns the current value of the reference counter.

methods.name: GetNewRefCountedSentData
methods.description: Creates a new shared CUDA IPC data object with reference counting and returns a DataPtr.

methods.name: CudaIPCCollect
methods.description: Performs cleanup of CUDA IPC shared data, returning true if memory was freed.
